prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Miami. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — to give accurate, local recommendations I need your Miami neighborhood or ZIP code and whether you (or your child) specifically prefer Invisalign or don’t mind traditional braces. Do you have insurance you want to use?

While you reply, here’s a practical plan and what to call/search for now (so you can start booking consults today):

Which offices to prioritize
- Board-certified orthodontists: look for DDS/DMD + orthodontic residency, and ideally American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) certification. Board certification is a strong signal of training and quality.
- Experienced Invisalign providers: prioritize Diamond or Platinum-level Invisalign providers (those have done many cases). If you prefer clear aligners, ask how many cases they have completed.
- University dental/orthodontic clinics: University of Miami (School of Dentistry) orthodontics clinic can be lower-cost and faculty-supervised — good option if budget matters.
- High-reviewed specialists near you: pick 3–5 local specialists with strong Google/Yelp reviews and before/after galleries to compare.

What to ask when you call (quick script)
- “Are you an orthodontic specialist (not a general dentist)? Are you board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics?”
- “Do you offer Invisalign? If yes, how many Invisalign cases have you completed and what level of Invisalign provider are you?”
- “Do you use digital scans (iTero) or do you still use impressions?”
- “What’s a typical timeline and cost estimate for my case (or for braces vs Invisalign)?”
- “Do you accept my insurance (name insurer) or what financing options do you offer?”
- “Do you include retainers in the fee? How are emergencies handled after hours?”
- “Can I see before/after photos of cases like mine and speak with recent patients or read testimonials?”

How to compare quickly (pick 3–4 factors)
- Credentials (orthodontic specialty + ABO)
- Experience with the treatment you want (number of Invisalign cases)
- Before/after photos and reviews
- Cost, insurance, financing, and estimated treatment time
- Location and appointment availability

If you want, I’ll pull up 4–6 specific orthodontists or clinics in your immediate area with phone numbers, short reasons to call each (credentials, Invisalign experience, price options, or university clinic), and a suggested order to contact them. Tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you prefer Invisalign, braces, or are open to both — and whether you have insurance.
